articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Vision, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process code, images, video, and audio within a single chain-of-thought pass. Benchmarks show a 37% improvement over GPT-5 on complex multi-step engineering tasks, with significantly reduced hallucination rates. The model also introduces a new 'structured tool use' protocol that lets it orchestrate multi-agent workflows natively.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Gold Medal Performance on International Math Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2 solved 5 out of 6 problems on a held-out set of 2026 IMO-level competition problems, matching gold-medal human performance. The system combines a refined AlphaProof-style formal verification loop with Gemini's natural language reasoning, enabling it to self-check proofs for logical soundness. This marks a significant step toward AI systems that can perform rigorous mathematical discovery.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Supervised Deployment in Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Amazon confirmed that Tesla's Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots have begun supervised shifts at two fulfillment centers in Texas, performing pick-and-place and bin-sorting tasks alongside human workers. The robots use an end-to-end vision-language-action model for task understanding and can adapt to novel object geometries without retraining. Amazon reports a 22% throughput improvement in mixed human-robot zones during the pilot phase.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Demonstrates Autonomous Construction Site Navigation and Tool Use
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released a video and technical blog detailing Atlas performing multi-step construction tasks including carrying materials up stairs, operating a power drill, and navigating unstructured debris fields without teleoperation. The system uses a hierarchical planning stack that combines a foundation world model with reactive low-level locomotion controllers. Industry observers note this is the most compelling demonstration yet of humanoid robots in unstructured real-world environments.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces 'Constitutional Classifiers' to Enable Safer Fine-Tuning of Open-Weight Models
articles.summary: Anthropic published a paper and open-source toolkit for Constitutional Classifiers, a method that embeds safety constraints directly into the fine-tuning objective so that downstream model adaptations provably preserve alignment properties. The approach uses formal specification of behavioral boundaries combined with adversarial training, and has been validated against red-team attacks that bypass conventional RLHF guardrails. The release is aimed at enterprise teams deploying fine-tuned models in regulated industries.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors has entered volume production at its Kaohsiung fab, with Apple and Nvidia among the first customers. The node delivers an 18% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, making it critical for next-generation AI accelerators with tighter thermal envelopes. TSMC also confirmed backside power delivery is integrated by default at this node.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Under Permissive License with 1 Trillion Parameter Mixture-of-Experts Architecture
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4, a 1T-parameter sparse MoE model activating roughly 140B parameters per forward pass, under a revised open license that permits commercial use with minimal restrictions. The model matches or exceeds GPT-5 on standard benchmarks while running on commodity 8×H100 clusters thanks to aggressive expert routing and quantization. The release includes fine-tuning recipes, a reference RLHF pipeline, and deployment tooling for Kubernetes-based inference at scale.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 600 Wh/kg in Independent Testing
articles.summary: QuantumScape's latest lithium-metal solid-state cell achieved a verified 600 Wh/kg energy density in independent tests conducted by Argonne National Laboratory, nearly doubling the density of current production lithium-ion cells. The cells maintained over 90% capacity after 1,000 fast-charge cycles, addressing the key durability concern that has stalled solid-state commercialization. The company announced a partnership with Volkswagen to begin integration into EV platforms starting in late 2027.
